factors.factor: Early goals for / against, first 5 and first 10 (both teams, two seasons + current)
Early shots on goal for / against, first 10 (opponent-adjusted through the opponent's suppression term)
Finishing (shooting %), shrunk toward the league
Starting goalie save %, shrunk; first-10-minute save % and last-5-start form shown
Confirmed vs projected starter (DailyFaceoff, with the reporter who confirmed)
Home ice
Back-to-back, 3-in-4, travel distance, time zones, rest edge (each side): full game after the 10th minute; switched off for the early window by the walk-forward test
Both teams on a back-to-back or 3-in-4 (mutual fatigue, first 10 minutes)
Time to first shot and first goal, games with no shot in the first 5
Early penalties taken and drawn (first 10)
Head-to-head meetings: first-goal time, early shots, goalies
Goalie workload: last start, shots faced, consecutive starts, started last night
Previous game went to overtime or a shootout
Goalie workload as a predictor (consecutive nights, long layoff): measured, no effect
Home arena as a predictor: measured, spread across arenas matches chance once team strength is in
League base rates by season (first 5 / first 10)
Expected goals (MoneyPuck shot quality): shot-quality rates for and against, finishing as goals over xG, goalie as goals over xG faced (2,808 games loaded)
High-danger chances, rush and rebound chances as separate inputs
Lines, pairs, power-play units, injuries and game-time decisions (DailyFaceoff)
Opening deployment, late scratches, officials, coaching
